outputs.explanation: Panel A contains a bar chart of cell death (%) reported as mean±s.d. of three independent experiments, with error bars shown but no individual data points overlaid on the bars. The panel also includes western blot images, which do not require individual data points.

Panel B contains a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars indicating variability across replicates, but no individual data points are shown. The panel also includes western blot images, which are exempt from this check.
Panel C is a grouped bar chart showing mean±s.d. of three experiments at multiple time points, with error bars but no individual data points overlaid.
Panel D contains a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars but no individual data points shown. The panel also includes western blot images, which do not require individual data points.
